title: Upgrading a packaging line
text:
A food manufacturer is upgrading one of its packaging lines. Two vendors work side by side. The first installs the new machines to a fixed plan. The second configures the control software in two-week iterations.

The machine crew complains that the software crew keeps changing the line's settings during the night shift. Both crews have stopped using the project's agreed rule that every change to the line is logged on the shared board. The plant manager wants the line running again in six weeks.
